note: GB10 shares one physical pool between CPU and GPU. The model is a file mapping read in place by the GPU, so it appears as page cache / RssFile and NOT as a CUDA allocation. nvidia-smi reports memory.used as N/A on this part.
kv_detail: 12 full-attention layers hold the whole context; 36 sliding layers are fixed at 128 tokens (18 MiB total)
mem_available_caveat: counts the model's page cache as reclaimable; reclaiming it forces the GPU to re-fault from NVMe. Treat system free, not MemAvailable, as the operator headroom.
cuda_allocation_source: nvtop -s gpu_mem_bytes_alloc (13641367552 bytes); this is KV + graph workspace + CUDA context
tooling_caveat: No GPU tool shows the model's footprint on this configuration. nvidia-smi reports memory.used as N/A on GB10; nvtop reports only explicit CUDA allocations (12.70 GiB) and its mem_free of 108.9 GiB, like MemAvailable's 103.6 GiB, counts the model's page cache as free. The model is a file mapping read in place, so its residency is visible only as RssFile / page cache. Genuine headroom is system free: 21.5 GiB.
